description: Save a spec into the project (default xsolana.json), only if it checks. A file that is already live keeps its program numbers and its live section. Never put a key in it: the checker refuses one.

file.description: A JSON file holding the spec, relative to the project folder (default: xsolana.json when it exists).

spec.description: An economy spec (version 2) given inline. Takes precedence over file and example.

name: xsolana_save
